_comment: Documented exceptions for `npm audit` high/critical advisories, consumed by scripts/audit-ci.mjs. Each entry is a GHSA id mapped to the reason it is temporarily accepted. NEW high/critical advisories that are not listed here will fail CI. Re-review periodically and remove entries once an upstream fix is adopted.

allow.GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8: nanoid <3.3.18 (transitive via postcss). Low impact: build-time only, no untrusted `size` input. Track patch bump.
allow.GHSA-4cwx-7wf7-3272: undici 7.x (transitive). Not used to proxy untrusted multi-tenant traffic in this app. Track patch bump.
allow.GHSA-7p8r-x3mc-p8w7: fast-uri 3.0.0-3.1.4 (transitive via ajv). Track patch bump to >=3.1.5.
allow.GHSA-hq66-cqwq-w95j: pdfjs-dist 5.x. Fix requires a major 5->6 upgrade; PDFs rendered are app-generated/user-supplied within the user's own session. Track deliberate major upgrade.
allow.GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv: extract-zip (via puppeteer-core/@puppeteer/browsers). No fixed version available upstream; only runs in serverless PDF rendering with trusted inputs.
allow.GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr: ip-address <=10.3.0 (transitive). No fixed version available upstream at time of triage.
allow.GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895: brace-expansion 4.0.0-5.0.8 (already pinned via package.json overrides to 5.0.8). No non-vulnerable release available yet upstream.
